outcome claim exempt from admission (claimed through the raw executor)
crossing-only identity (the owner context always matches)
premature release: the slots are released right after the identity lookup
foreign-record cleanup: clear() empties the slot whoever holds it
provider lease dropped from the active scope
replacement eligibility dropped (a vacated binding is replaced even with an owner)
binding is not failure-atomic (records while validating)
all-or-none broken: a refused acquisition keeps what it reserved
a Host crossing is never marked (emitter, executor, clock)
the overlap refusal is retried like a conflict (transactRequest does not rethrow it)

the inventory trusts a method name of any object (F266-14)
